## vMLX 1.6.25 for macOS

Built from source commit `81f90bbb3`.

### Highlights

- DeepSeek V4 Flash long-context prompt processing is dramatically faster: a new indexed-attention prefill kernel (on by default) lifts prefill from 347 to ~449 tokens/s at 15k context (+29%) and from 199 to ~316 tokens/s at 40k (+58%), with decode holding 33+ tokens/s sustained.
- Aborting and retrying a long prompt is no longer a cold start — the engine rewinds the live KV cache to the shared prefix, dropping retry time-to-first-token at 15k context from 46s to 2.3s.
- Extreme context lengths fail honestly instead of crashing: the engine advertises the true hardware ceiling at startup, shrinks prefill chunks adaptively under Metal memory pressure, and refuses over-ceiling requests with a clean error instead of a Metal OOM.
- A prompt that is too long now shows a clear in-chat message instead of a raw error dialog, and an oversized message no longer poisons every later turn of that conversation.
- Fixes for stripped-vision-tower checkpoints, hybrid SSM stream completion, VLM JANG quantization module selection, Laguna-S-2.1-JANG_4M loading, disk (L2) cache stale-index and fingerprint poisoning, auto-sleep firing mid-generation, and frozen relative timestamps.

Separate signed and Apple-notarized Apple-silicon downloads are available for macOS Tahoe and Sequoia-compatible systems. Tahoe is the default download.
